import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianCut

# Define jet multiplicity binning
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    "njets",
    {
        "exactly_4j": lambda events: ak.sum(events.JetGood, axis=1) == 4,
        "exactly_5j": lambda events: ak.sum(events.JetGood, axis=1) == 5,
        "at_least_6j": lambda events: ak.sum(events.JetGood, axis=1) >= 6,
    }
)

# Define b-tag multiplicity binning
btag_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    "nbtags",
    {
        "exactly_2b": lambda events: ak.sum(events.JetGood.btag, axis=1) == 2,
        "at_least_3b": lambda events: ak.sum(events.JetGood.btag, axis=1) >= 3,
    }
)

# Create cartesian product of jet multiplicity × b-tag multiplicity categories
categories = CartesianCut(jet_multiplicity, btag_multiplicity)
